observations: body L1-L8: the end of Henry Bate's words begun on p. 308. The dots after «stella» (L1) are five, those before the closing quotation (L5) three. «al–Battānī» (L6) has a long dash (5.4 pt) and is not letter-spaced; the o of «hypotenusa» (L8) prints broken. The leg of the right spherical triangle from the other leg (the latitude) and the hypotenuse (the ray) is the computation of pp. 307-308, cos x = R cos 60° : cos β.

body L9-L15: the dash after «II.» measures 8.6 pt, the long dash of «al–Battānī» (L9) 5.3 pt. The Greek ἀκτινοβολία (L10) is set as printed; its kappa is printed in the curly form (ϰ). «Salmasius» and «Bouché–Leclercq» are letter-spaced. The page numbers «398–» and «–409» (L11-L12) are divided with the dash at the end of L11 (joined to the 8, about 4.8 pt) and repeated at the beginning of L12 (5.9 pt), as printed; «Bouché–Leclercq» and «247–51» have long dashes (5.4 and 5.3 pt).
body L16-L18: «al–Qabīṣī» and «Abrāhām Ibn ‘Ezrā» are letter-spaced; the long dash of «al–Qabīṣī» is joined to the l (about 4.6 pt); «Alcabitium» is not letter-spaced.

body L19-L29: «Ibn Hibintà» (L19, L21), «Hermetem», «Dorotheus», «Muḥammad», «ibn al–Farrukhān» and «Hermetis» are letter-spaced; «ibn ‘Omar» (L22) is not. The Arabic word of L20 is العرض, printed with a kashida after the ‘ayn. «al–Farrukhān» has a long dash (5.4 pt). Addenda, p. LXXIX («309, adn. 2»): that the title of Hermes' book is al-‘arḍ, «the book of latitude», appears from an-Nadīm, al-Fihrist p. 267, who names Hermes' كتاب عرض مفتاح النجوم الاول «first book of latitude, key of the stars» and كتاب طول مفتاح النجوم الثاني «second book of longitude, key of the stars» (in Suter's version, p. 19, «Ueber die Breite, erster Schlüssel der Gestirne; Ueber die Länge, zweiter Schlüssel der Gestirne»; but then ‘arḍ and ṭūl ought to have the article); Ibn al-Qifṭī, ed. Lippert p. 349, leaves out طول «of longitude» in the title of the second book; the version of ‘Alī ibn Riḍwān's commentary on the Tetrabiblos has liber accidentium, l. accidentis, l. de accidentibus, l. latitudinis, places collected by Steinschneider ad Baldi p. 473 (less well in extr. p. 43).

body L30-L31: «Valens», «az–Zarqālī» and «Rabiçag de Toledo» are letter-spaced; «az–Zarqālī» and «204–5» have long dashes (5.5 pt each). Addenda, p. LXXIX («309–310»): that Valens' method in the radiations does not differ from Ptolemy's is attested by az-Zarqālī, l. c. («et por esta obra obraua Uuelius el egiptiano en los echamientos de los rayos. et es la oppinion de Ptolomeo») and by Rabiçag, l. c. («et segund esto obraua en echamiento de los rayos Vellix ell egipciano. que es opinion de Ptolomeo. Et esto es lo que dixo Abumassal [Abū Ma‘shar] et Abuzac Azarquiel [Abū Isḥāq az-Zarqālī]»); but the list of chapters of the book al-bāri‘ of Abū Naṣr al-Qummī (about 360 H., 971), in Ahlwardt, Verzeichniss, vol. V, p. 148,b, nr. 5661, has two chapters, one «on the projection of the rays according to the method of Ptolemy», the other «on the projection of the rays according to Valens».
notes_left L1-L8: «Abdilazi», «Alchabitius», «Alchabitii» and «Suter» are letter-spaced. The dash before «Fuit» (L7) measures 7.7 pt; «60-61» has a hyphen (3.2 pt).
notes_left L9-L16: «al-‘araḍ» (L9) has a hyphen (2.8 pt) and «al–‘arḍ» (L11) a long dash (4.6 pt); «Steinschneider» and «Omar» are letter-spaced. Note 3 goes on in the right column (L1-L3).

notes_right L1-L16: «Firmici», «Suter», «Salmasius», «Bouché-Leclercq», «Reiss» and «Kroll» are letter-spaced; the dash before «Fuit» (L2) measures 8.3 pt, and the dash of «Bouché-Leclercq» (L14) 4.2 pt, the length of the hyphens of the notes. The parenthesis after the quotation of L6 prints only in its upper part, like an apostrophe, and the t of «et t III» (L9) is printed without a full stop. Addenda, p. LXXIX («309, adn. 5»): for «Reiss» read «Riess».
